\[
\sqrt{(\sqrt{56})(\sqrt{126})}
\]

Simplify each square root:
\[
\sqrt{56}=\sqrt{4\cdot 14}=2\sqrt{14}
\]
\[
\sqrt{126}=\sqrt{9\cdot 14}=3\sqrt{14}
\]

Multiply:
\[
(\sqrt{56})(\sqrt{126})=(2\sqrt{14})(3\sqrt{14})=6\cdot 14=84
\]

Then take the outer square root:
\[
\sqrt{84}=\sqrt{4\cdot 21}=2\sqrt{21}
\]

So \(a=2\) and \(b=21\), giving:
\[
a+b=2+21=23
\]

The answer is 23.
